uncited: **Conditional Positional Encoding (CPE):** Apply CPE to the sampled texture features $F_{tex}$ to recover high-frequency details lost by regularization.
*   **RGB Loss ($L_{rgb}$):** Mean squared error between rendered and ground truth colors.
*   **Point-wise RGB Loss ($L_{pt\_rgb}$):** Encourages consistency at sampled points.
*   **Background Loss ($L_{bg}$):** Encourages foreground/background separation by penalizing intermediate transmittance values.
*   **Total Variation Loss ($L_{TV}$):** Applied directly to the voxel grids of the density and texture volumes to prevent over-fitting and maintain geometry.
*   **Over-smoothing:** Total variation loss causes blurring and loss of high-frequency details.
*   **Initialization Collapse:** Applying CPE to density features breaks the zero-initialization rule required for stable volume rendering at the start of training.
*   **Spatial Awareness:** Using low-resolution images to predict LUT weights loses 3D spatial awareness.
*   **Training Time:** Training requires 250k iterations for datasets [23] and 100k for datasets [21].
